nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Gaussian process regression was used to estimate the normative range of regional gray matter volumes based on age and sex in healthy controls. The trained model was then applied to each patient to generate predicted GMVs, and Z scores were calculated to quantify deviations from normal distributions.
